===================================================================================================
ADDENDUM B: EXHAUSTIVE API PAYLOADS & RESPONSES (PART 1)
===================================================================================================

This addendum strictly defines the REST API contract. The Flutter client must generate its data transfer objects (DTOs) via Freezed/Retrofit to perfectly match these schemas.

B.1. AUTHENTICATION MODULE (`/api/v1/auth`)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ENDPOINT: `POST /api/v1/auth/register`
Description: Registers a new user account.
Access: Public
Headers:
  Content-Type: application/json
Request Body Schema:
{
  "firstName": { "type": "string", "required": true, "minLength": 2, "maxLength": 50 },
  "lastName": { "type": "string", "required": true, "minLength": 2, "maxLength": 50 },
  "email": { "type": "string", "format": "email", "required": true },
  "password": { "type": "string", "required": true, "minLength": 8, "description": "Must contain 1 uppercase, 1 number, 1 special character." },
  "role": { "type": "string", "enum": ["USER", "ADMIN"], "required": false, "default": "USER" }
}
Response 201 Created:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User registered successfully.",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "60d0fe4f5311236168a109ca",
      "firstName": "John",
      "lastName": "Doe",
      "email": "john.doe@example.com",
      "role": "USER",
      "status": "ACTIVE",
      "createdAt": "2026-06-05T12:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}
Response 400 Bad Request (Validation):
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Invalid input data",
    "details": [
      { "field": "password", "message": "Password must contain at least one special character." }
    ]
  }
}
Response 409 Conflict:
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS",
    "message": "A user with this email already exists."
  }
}

ENDPOINT: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
Description: Authenticates a user and issues tokens.
Access: Public
Headers:
  Content-Type: application/json
Request Body Schema:
{
  "email": { "type": "string", "format": "email", "required": true },
  "password": { "type": "string", "required": true }
}
Response 200 OK:
Headers:
  Set-Cookie: refreshToken=eyJhb...; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=604800
Body:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "expiresIn": 900,
    "user": {
      "id": "60d0fe4f5311236168a109ca",
      "firstName": "John",
      "lastName": "Doe",
      "email": "john.doe@example.com",
      "role": "USER",
      "status": "ACTIVE"
    }
  }
}
Response 401 Unauthorized:
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
    "message": "Incorrect email or password."
  }
}
Response 403 Forbidden (Pending Approval):
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ACCOUNT_PENDING_APPROVAL",
    "message": "Your account is pending administrator approval."
  }
}

ENDPOINT: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`
Description: Rotates the access token using the HTTP-only refresh token cookie.
Access: Public (Requires valid cookie)
Headers:
  Cookie: refreshToken=eyJhb...
Request Body: Empty.
Response 200 OK:
Headers:
  Set-Cookie: refreshToken=eyJhb...; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=604800
Body:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "expiresIn": 900
  }
}
Response 401 Unauthorized:
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "TOKEN_EXPIRED",
    "message": "Refresh token expired. Please login again."
  }
}

ENDPOINT: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`
Description: Invalidates the current refresh token and clears the cookie.
Access: Protected
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
Request Body: Empty.
Response 200 OK:
Headers:
  Set-Cookie: refreshToken=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT
Body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Logged out successfully."
}

B.2. WORKSPACE MODULE (`/api/v1/workspaces`)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ENDPOINT: `GET /api/v1/workspaces`
Description: Lists all workspaces the user has access to within the current organization.
Access: Protected
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
Query Parameters:
  page: integer (default 1)
  limit: integer (default 20)
Response 200 OK:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "workspaces": [
      {
        "id": "60d0fe4f5311236168a109cb",
        "organizationId": "60d0fe4f5311236168a109cc",
        "name": "Engineering",
        "description": "Software development team.",
        "icon": "💻",
        "color": "#3B82F6",
        "isPrivate": false,
        "createdAt": "2026-06-01T10:00:00.000Z",
        "updatedAt": "2026-06-01T10:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "pagination": {
      "total": 5,
      "page": 1,
      "limit": 20,
      "totalPages": 1
    }
  }
}
Response 401 Unauthorized: Standard 401 response.
Response 403 Forbidden: Standard 403 response if user is not in the organization.

ENDPOINT: `POST /api/v1/workspaces`
Description: Creates a new workspace.
Access: Protected (Requires `MANAGE_WORKSPACE` permission)
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
  Content-Type: application/json
Request Body Schema:
{
  "name": { "type": "string", "required": true, "maxLength": 100 },
  "description": { "type": "string", "required": false, "maxLength": 1000 },
  "icon": { "type": "string", "required": false },
  "color": { "type": "string", "required": false, "pattern": "^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$" },
  "isPrivate": { "type": "boolean", "required": false, "default": false }
}
Response 201 Created:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "workspace": { ... } // Full workspace object
  }
}
Response 400 Bad Request:
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "DUPLICATE_WORKSPACE_NAME",
    "message": "A workspace with this name already exists in the organization."
  }
}

ENDPOINT: `PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/:id`
Description: Updates workspace details.
Access: Protected (Requires `MANAGE_WORKSPACE` permission)
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>

Description: Creates a new task.

Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
  Content-Type: application/json
Request Body Schema:
{
  "projectId": { "type": "string", "required": true },
  "title": { "type": "string", "required": true, "maxLength": 255 },
  "description": { "type": "string", "required": false },
  "status": { "type": "string", "default": "TODO" },
  "priority": { "type": "string", "enum": ["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "URGENT"], "default": "MEDIUM" },
  "dueDate": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "required": false },
  "parentId": { "type": "string", "required": false, "description": "If this is a subtask" },
  "assigneeIds": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "required": false },
  "tagIds": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "required": false }
}
Response 201 Created:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "task": { ... }
  }
}

ENDPOINT: `PATCH /api/v1/tasks/:id`
Description: Updates a task. This is the primary mutation endpoint queued by the offline Sync Engine.
Access: Protected
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
  Content-Type: application/json
Request Body Schema:
{
  "title": { "type": "string", "required": false },
  "description": { "type": "string", "required": false },
  "status": { "type": "string", "required": false },
  "priority": { "type": "string", "required": false },
  "dueDate": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "required": false },
  "position": { "type": "number", "required": false },
  "expectedVersion": { "type": "integer", "required": true, "description": "Used for optimistic concurrency control to detect conflicts." }
}
Response 200 OK:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "task": { ... }
  }
}
Response 409 Conflict:
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VERSION_CONFLICT",
    "message": "The task has been modified by another user. Please refresh and try again.",
    "data": {
      "latestTaskState": { ... }
    }
  }
}

ENDPOINT: `POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/assign`
Description: Assigns users to a task idempotently.

  Content-Type: application/json

CREATE TABLE statuss (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  isActive NUMERIC,
  createdAt NUMERIC,
  updatedAt NUMERIC,
  createdAt TEXT NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER DEFAULT 1
);

{

2. REST API ENDPOINTS: Status
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENDPOINT: GET /api/v1/statuss
Description: List all Statuss with pagination and filtering.
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
Expected Responses:
  - 200: Success. Returns the requested data.
  - 400: Bad Request. Validation failed.
  - 401: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid token.
  - 403: Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
  - 500: Internal Server Error.

ENDPOINT: GET /api/v1/statuss/:id
Description: Get a specific Status by ID.
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
Expected Responses:
  - 200: Success. Returns the requested data.
  - 400: Bad Request. Validation failed.
  - 401: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid token.
  - 403: Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
  - 404: Not Found. Resource does not exist.
  - 500: Internal Server Error.

ENDPOINT: POST /api/v1/statuss
Description: Create a new Status.
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>
  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
Request Body Schema:
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "isActive": "boolean",
  "createdAt": "datetime",
  "updatedAt": "datetime",
}
Expected Responses:
  - 201: Created. Returns the newly created data.
  - 400: Bad Request. Validation failed.
  - 401: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid token.
  - 403: Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
  - 500: Internal Server Error.

ENDPOINT: PATCH /api/v1/statuss/:id
Description: Update an existing Status.
Headers:

  X-Organization-ID: <orgId>
Request Body Schema:
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "isActive": "boolean",
  "createdAt": "datetime",
  "updatedAt": "datetime",
}
Expected Responses:
  - 200: Success. Returns the requested data.
  - 400: Bad Request. Validation failed.
  - 401: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid token.
  - 403: Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
  - 404: Not Found. Resource does not exist.

ENDPOINT: DELETE /api/v1/statuss/:id
